convert_relative_import_to_absolute: convert a relative libcst import node to an absolute import using file path and package name
convert_to_relative_import: convert an absolute libcst import node to a relative import within the target package
build_absolute_import_transformer: build a libcst CSTTransformer that converts all relative imports to absolute imports in a Python file
build_relative_import_transformer: build a libcst CSTTransformer that converts all absolute imports to relative imports within a package
check_excluded_external_files: check the EXCLUDED_EXTERNAL_FILES list to skip external library files from tracking
